p: Command the children of Israel: Read Ex 27:20.
of the testimony: Which separated the holiest of holies, where the ark of the testimony from the sanctuary was.
tenth deals shall be in one: That is, two omers, read Ex 16:16.
it may be on the bread: For it was burnt every sabbath, when the bread was taken away.
out among the children of Israel: Meaning, out of his tent.
blasphemed the name of the LORD: By swearing or despising God.
bear his sin: Shall be punished.
Moses spake to the children of: Because the punishment was not yet appointed by the law for the blasphemer, Moses consulted with the Lord, and told the people what God commanded.
